name: Images
reading: Images: 4 typestates over 4 checker nodes, lookahead 0; 5 rules (the start and one per typestate: in it each next typestate is possible and nothing else is). Faithfulness is decided as one bisimulation check: pass faithful a task or lean to compare a model with this protocol

rules.formula: (AG (implies (and (after GetImage) (not terminal)) (and (EX #0=(and (after Image) terminal)) (EX #1=(and (after NotFound) terminal)) (AX (or #0# #1#)))))
rules.name: typestate 1: GetImage
rules.notation: AG ((GetImage ∧ ¬terminal) → (EX (Image ∧ terminal) ∧ EX (NotFound ∧ terminal) ∧ AX ((Image ∧ terminal) ∨ (NotFound ∧ terminal))))
